"import cadquery as cq

# Dimensions (mm)
d1 = 36.0   # Segment 1 diameter
d2 = 24.0   # Segment 2 diameter
d3 = 14.0   # Segment 3 diameter
dbore = 6.0 # Central bore diameter
r1 = d1 / 2
r2 = d2 / 2
r3 = d3 / 2
rbore = dbore / 2

h1 = 25.0   # Segment 1 height
h2 = 30.0   # Segment 2 height
h3 = 18.0   # Segment 3 height
total_h = h1 + h2 + h3  # 73.0

# Build stepped shaft and cut central bore in one fluent chain
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .circle(r1).extrude(h1)                                # Segment 1
    .faces(">Z").workplane().circle(r2).extrude(h2)        # Segment 2 stacked on Segment 1
    .faces(">Z").workplane().circle(r3).extrude(h3)        # Segment 3 stacked on Segment 2
    .faces(">Z").workplane().circle(rbore).cutThruAll()    # Central through bore
)

# Export final single solid
cq.exporters.export(result, "part.step")"
